disclaimer: Blocker diagnosis on a public checkpoint sample. Not a production ratio and not a 1–2 GB / 8 GB claim.

model.full_model_note: Checkpoint has 290 16-bit tensors; this diagnosis uses the Stage 1B 42-tensor linear/attention sample.

summary.note: Mantissa entropy stays near 7 bits. On this Qwen sample, uint16 spatial residuals are *higher* than H(uint16), and exponent spatial residuals are *higher* than H(exp). Exact duplicate tiles are zero at 64/256/1024 (including same-role across layers). uint16 spatial beats raw only in the ideal no-codebook sense; complete container cost loses on every tile.
